events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between 14th and 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for the launch of Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product discovery, refreshments, samples, giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ sample, refreshments and croissants while supplies last; scratch-off prizes are available, and the first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite listing is organized by BOBBI BROWN Cosmetics and provides the actionable registration page. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video content will be captured at the activation for Bobbi Brown social/digital use.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. The first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary x SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-themed Apothékary takeover of SUKOSHI with tongue readings, tincture sampling, ingredient education and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests in line each day receive a complimentary mini Apothékary tincture. Tincture samples and kakigori are offered, with kakigori subject to availability. Purchases receive 20% off and a gift with purchase while supplies last.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite page is organized by Apothékary and lists multiple dates. The first-50 mini tincture is quantity-limited each day; kakigori and gifts are while supplies last. The 20% discount and gift-with-purchase are purchase-dependent, but general admission and sampling are not described as requiring a purchase.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 18 runs 1–9 PM; Saturday September 19 and Sunday September 20 run 9 AM–9 PM. Use the Eventbrite page to select the applicable date.
